tagline.en_US: Community Home Assistant OS image, derived from HAOS One, adapted as a native Proxmox OCI LXC with persistent Supervisor, Core, add-ons and backups under /mnt/data.

description.en_US: HAOS One provides a fully featured Home Assistant Operating System environment, including Home Assistant Core, Supervisor, and add-ons. It allows users to centralize control of smart home devices, build automations, and manage integrations. The system provides access to supervisor capabilities, enabling users to install add-on applications and manage backups directly.
